items.title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist
items.summary: Cybersecurity experts have long warned of the persistent and patient threat from North Korea's long-running hacks. The world's largest crypto exchange was still caught off-guard.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
items.summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3  billion round led by Bessemer.
items.creator: Marina Temkin

items.title: Reddit tests ads in search results as traffic declines and growth concerns mount
items.summary: The new ad placements could help Reddit squeeze more revenue from existing users as Google's AI search changes how people discover its content.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Ten years later, ‘Pokémon Go to the polls’ still haunts the internet
items.summary: Hillary Clinton's 2016 political gaffe has become an irony-shrouded rallying cry for jaded young voters who still dare to hope for change.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling
